International / Other Qualification view of the programme (Sept 2027 entry). The scheme awards either the BSc (Hons) in Computer Science or the BSc (Hons) in Enterprise Information Systems; students may enrol in either award 'without being subject to further assessment', so the CS bachelor exists as an award of this scheme.
